parole.significato: sap or resin of a tree
parole.testo: Considering the trees in question palms, from the Sauraseni Prakrit predecessor of Hindi ताड़ी (tāṛī, “palm-sap, toddy”), and based on a relation to pines via Aramaic – encountered as Jewish Palestinian Aramaic דדינין, דדנין (daddīnīn, plural), Classical Syriac ܕܐܕܝܢ (/⁠dāḏīn⁠/) – from Ancient Greek
